## Completeness, checked against the official sources (2026-11-12)

| Constitution | Main codes | National law | Law-making regions | Case law |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| held | 67% | 50% | not applicable | 0% |

The Constitution is held with its full in-force history through the 2019 Prespa Amendments XXXIII-XXXVI and matches the Constitutional Court's official consolidated text word for word. The codes are weak: the Criminal Code and the Law on Obligations are held back, the Labour, Criminal Procedure and General Administrative Procedure laws are held as enacted without their amendments (37, 4 and 1 amending acts or Court decisions not applied), and the Civil Procedure law shown is the 2026 law that applies only from 2027-01-18, while the 2005 law still applied today is held back. No court decisions.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
